# Flizy

> Send money by phone number, email or username, from WhatsApp, Telegram or the web. GIWA-first, testnet.

Money commands run in the chat app the user already has, and the same account can be linked
on WhatsApp and Telegram at once. Raw wallet addresses only work once saved on the site with
the account password, and a new one waits 24 hours before it can receive. Swaps only go through allowlisted
DEX routers, with fees disclosed before confirmation. Currently running on GIWA Sepolia
testnet with source-verified contracts.

## Site

- https://flizy.app/ : Product home and four-step overview
- https://flizy.app/how-it-works : Full user guide and commands for both chat apps
- https://flizy.app/docs : Trusted destinations, invite counting rules
- https://flizy.app/terms : Terms of service
- https://flizy.app/privacy : Privacy policy, including TikTok user.info.basic
- https://flizy.app/pay/:code : Pay a Flizy account by username or printed code, in ETH or FLZ. First payment is flagged; after success you can save them as a trusted contact.
- https://flizy.app/signup : Create account (email + verification code + username)
- https://flizy.app/login : Sign in
- https://flizy.app/dashboard : Wallet, personal invite link, PIN, trusted people, chat link code
- https://flizy.app/dashboard/wallet : Flizy wallet address and fund steps
- https://flizy.app/dashboard/swap : Swap FLZ and ETH, add or remove liquidity
- https://flizy.app/i/:username : Personal invite. Attributes a new signup to that @username
- https://flizy.app/claim/:token/:username : Claim funds. Trailing username is the invite when attached
- https://faucet.giwa.io : Official GIWA testnet faucet — paste Flizy wallet address to receive test ETH
- https://x.com/Flizyapp : Official X account

## Channels

- WhatsApp: commands are prefixed, for example `flizy send 0.01 to john`, then `confirm`.
- Telegram: slash commands, for example `/send 0.01 to john`, confirm by button or by typing.
- Listed NFT identity send uses the same escrow: `nft send giwaforge 1842 to @bob on telegram`. Collections studio is a separate site and is not this command.
- One site link code binds either channel. Identity is proven by that code, because only a
  logged-in account holder can generate one.
- Claims can be addressed to a phone number, an email, or a platform account. One phone
  belongs to exactly one account.
- Sending to a phone number always reserves the funds, whether or not that number is
  already on Flizy. If it is, the owner is notified in their chat app immediately and
  claims it there. The sender can cancel until it is claimed.

## When to read

- Read /how-it-works to onboard a human user on WhatsApp or Telegram.
- Read /docs when a send is rejected for destination policy.
- Read /dashboard flows for link codes and trusted address management.
